tagline: Capital One is a diversified financial services company offering credit cards, auto loans, home loans, and deposit products to millions of customers.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total net revenue is the primary indicator of the size and growth of the company in the financial services sector. It reflects Capital One's overall activity from its lending, deposit, and payment services businesses.

kpis.name: Total net revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company from net interest income and non-interest income.
kpis.description: Total net revenue is a key measure of financial performance, indicating the company's ability to generate revenue from its core lending and deposit-taking activities.

kpis.name: Net interest income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned on loans and deposits and interest expenses paid on deposits and borrowings.
kpis.description: Indicates the profitability of the company's lending and deposit-taking activities, a major component of total revenue.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in net interest income.

kpis.name: Provision for credit losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover expected losses on loans and other receivables based on economic conditions.
kpis.description: Reflects management's anticipation of future loan losses, often linked to deteriorating economic conditions and loan portfolio growth.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase in provisions for credit losses.

kpis.name: Total non-interest expense
kpis.explanation: Operating costs of the company, excluding interest expenses, including marketing expenses and operating costs.
kpis.description: Includes marketing expenses, salaries, and other operating costs necessary for running the business and growing the loan portfolio.

kpis.short: Income from continuing operations, net of tax
kpis.name: Income from continuing operations, net of tax
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by the company after taxes, excluding discontinued or ceased operations.
kpis.description: A key indicator of the company's overall profitability from its core operations, before extraordinary items.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in net income from continuing operations.
kpis.name_en: Income from continuing operations, net of tax

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Total profit of the company after all expenses, provisions, and taxes, including both continuing and discontinued operations.
kpis.description: The final result of the company's financial performance for the period, including $365 million in income from discontinued operations.

kpis.name: Loans held for investment
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans the company intends to hold to maturity, including auto, mortgage, and credit card loans.
kpis.description: Indicates significant expansion in the company's lending activities and its revenue-generating asset base.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of everything the company owns, including loans, investments, cash, and other assets.
kpis.description: Represents the overall size of the company and its resources available for lending and investment activities.

kpis.name: Common equity
kpis.explanation: Value of common shares held by shareholders, representing their ownership stake in the company.
kpis.description: Indicates a significant increase in the company's net worth for common shareholders, reflecting growth and capitalization.

kpis.name: Common shares outstanding
kpis.explanation: Total number of common shares issued and held by investors at the end of the period.
kpis.description: Indicates significant dilution for existing shareholders, related to acquisitions and financing of loan portfolio growth.

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.8 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $1.768 B in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 72.1% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net charge-off rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of loans charged off (deemed uncollectible) relative to total loans held for investment.
kpis.description: Measures the quality of the loan portfolio and the effectiveness of credit risk management, with a stable rate despite portfolio growth.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in net charge-off rate.

kpis.name: Common dividend payout ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net income available to common shareholders allocated to cash dividend payments.
kpis.description: Indicates an increased capital return policy to common shareholders through dividends, rising from 20.67% in 2024 to 64.52% in 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in common dividend payout ratio.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on net income
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, detailed analysis with shock scenarios up to +/-200 bp. Language emphasizes direct impact on net income and economic value. Downward sensitivity at -200 bp represents a 2.7% loss, worse than 2024 (-1.9%), indicating deterioration. Macro category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on economic value
risks.score_rationale: Detailed analysis in the 10-K, measuring economic value of equity (EVE). A 200 bp increase reduces EVE by 4.5%, although improved from 2024 (-6.3%). Integration of Discover has altered asset structure, increasing sensitivity. Critical Macro category.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on earnings
risks.score_rationale: Disclosed in Market Risk section, with exposures in GBP, CAD, and EUR. Measured via 1% dollar shock. Exposure is significant ($1.5 Bn GBP, $1.1 Bn CAD, €505 M). Hedged with derivatives, but residual risk possible. Macro category, moderate to high intensity.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on equity
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to translation of equity in GBP and CAD ($2.3 Bn GBP, $2.8 Bn CAD). Measured via 30% dollar shock. Managed with currency hedges, but residual risk on capital ratios. Explicitly mentioned in foreign exchange risks, high attention level.

risks.title: Derivatives for commercial clients
risks.score_rationale: Risk specifically mentioned in a dedicated section. COF offers derivatives to its clients and offsets them with counterparties. Uses VaR as primary measure. Residual market risk possible in case of counterparty default or imperfect hedging. Less central than interest rate risks, but present.

risks.title: Unfunded lending commitments
risks.score_rationale: High level of unfunded commitments: $729.6 Bn in 2025 vs $458.1 Bn in 2024, a 60% increase. Managed through strict credit standards, but potential for massive exposure in case of simultaneous draws. Mentioned in contractual obligations, cautious language but no explicit alarm.

risks.title: Credit ratings and market access
risks.score_rationale: First risk mentioned in Item 1A: a downgrade in ratings could severely impact liquidity, funding costs, and market access. Current ratings stable (Moody's, Fitch) or positive (S&P), but critical exposure. Strong language: 'could significantly impact'. Capital category, existential level.

ai_positioning.summary: The company did not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar terms in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F report. Therefore, its positioning on AI cannot be determined from this information.
